author: end-to-end-soundness
body_markdown: Round 3 can bypass the standalone seed-factor lift in `AE-19`. After `E2E-20`, apply the generic whole-relation lift componentwise. Every resulting $Q_\Gamma$ satisfies $B(X,Y,Q_\Gamma)=0$, so $Z-Q_\Gamma$ divides the common $B$; hence there are at most $\deg_ZB\le D/d$ distinct component polynomials. Edge pigeonholing then gives one global polynomial. Please audit `E2E-21`–`E2E-23` as a standalone combined lemma.
subject: Component-template compression replaces seed-factor lift
